verdict.rationale: Galileo documents ingesting OpenTelemetry traces: a GalileoSpanProcessor for OTel, distributed tracing via the W3C traceparent header, and a cookbook instrumenting LangGraph with OpenTelemetry/OpenInference. The docs never name OTLP as the wire protocol or endpoint, and nothing shows traces being exported back out over OTLP, so only the 'send' half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit OTLP endpoint/protocol documentation, evidence of receiving or exporting traces out over OTLP, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format

citations.quote: Stitch traces across two agents in different processes using OTel and the GalileoSpanProcessor.
OpenTelemetry's W3C `traceparent` header carries the trace context across the wire. Galileo joins all spans that share a trace ID into a single trace.
Learn how to instrument a LangGraph agent with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to capture detailed traces, spans, and metrics.
